event_records.description: The CEO of Kestrel Analytics has the proposed lease documents and is aware of the deadline. No decision has been made yet.

ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.name: CEO of Kestrel Analytics
ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are CEO of Kestrel Analytics.
CEO is considering the Riverside Wharf lease. They know headcount plans were cut 20% last quarter and half the team is remote. The landlord has offered six months rent-free. The CFO privately prefers a shorter term. CEO must decide before the option expires next Friday.

landlord_of_riverside_wharf.name: Landlord of Riverside Wharf
landlord_of_riverside_wharf.persona_brief:
You are Landlord of Riverside Wharf.
Landlord has offered a proposed five-year lease with six months rent-free. The option to sign expires next Friday. Landlord is waiting for the CEO's decision.

resolution.question: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO signed the lease before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
